observations.finding: No credential-pattern literal match in the scanned file bytes. Other secret formats remain possible; this is a scanner result, not universal absence proof.

Email/phone/auth-header candidates are reserved or explicitly synthetic test values. AR01 annual-review email is inherited from test/fixtures/step13e7b-production-annual-normal-release-rebind.sql and associated with synthetic UUID000...091; no message sender is invoked.
No changed shipping native path in the Git scope. Added Swift files are test-only retained DTO/model copies with a manifest and a disposable decoder driver.

Recovery never opens score permission. Current authenticated identity/membership is rechecked and exact accepted receipt is scoped by match, tournament, actor and immutable originating Auth UUID. Legacy NULL and foreign/no receipt remain UNKNOWN. No auth-before-receipt bypass introduced.

No new end-user table/function grants or RLS disable found. Migration123 removes only a hash-verified obsolete false-only writer constraint and retains the positive certified writer invariant. This is source review; executed role/RLS evidence is separate.

No new application/tool path bypasses the canonical score RPC to write competitive authority. Direct synthetic DML in isolated fixture construction and fault injection is identified as such; full-round scores use canonical RPC.

Benchmark and integration tooling create owned temporary socket-only PostgreSQL clusters and pass validated identity to child transports. Remote provider inputs are not accepted by test/benchmark CLI; provider env is stripped and Node net/tls is fenced. This does not establish an OS network sandbox.

Operational run-score-derived-worker.mjs intentionally resolves configured current runtime and can mutate derived jobs when separately invoked with credentials. It is not invoked by the Phase2C test runner, benchmark, or package scripts. It must be excluded from local-proof instructions unless supplied a reviewed isolated adapter.

Provider project/workbook IDs and Production hostnames retained in inherited authority/DTO fixtures are nonsecret metadata, not connection instructions executed by these tests. Native decoder uses retained model decoding, not URLSession requests.
Tracked git diff --check completed with exit0. This does not check untracked file whitespace or imply compilation.

limitations: No runtime test or database query executed for this review.
